 ‘That’s how he gets all his steals’ – Jake LaRavia hails underrated LA Lakers teammate making an impact
 Dan Coombs
 Mon 16 November 2026 17:46 GMT · 2 min read Add to Preferred Sources Photo by Luke Hales/Getty Images Add to Preferred Sources 
 LA Lakers star Jake LaRavia has hailed the impact of one of the team’s new additions. 
 Now in his second year with the LA Lakers, Jake LaRavia has witnessed lots of personnel changes, including LeBron James’ exit in the summer.
 Speaking after the team’s 131-123 win over the Phoenix Suns, LaRavia talked up new addition Matisse Thybulle.
 Thybulle has been a significant boost to the Lakers defense, leading the team with three steals against the Suns. He was +30 in +- figures.
 LaRavia said that Thybulle makes it look easy, commenting: “He gets a lot of steals. He’s a very underrated defender. 
 “Honestly, when I’m on the court with him, it literally just looks like the other team’s throwing the ball to him half the time, that’s how he gets all his steals. It’s crazy, just that he finds himself in every gap.”
 LaRavia talked up Thybulle’s connection with Luka Doncic, and while he has tried to encourage him not to take any defensive risks – he knows his teammate has delivered.
 He said: “I tell him all the time, don’t gamble every possession because, sometimes it can hurt. But I just think he’s done a really good job at being solid. 
 “He’s playing really well with Luka right now, playing off-ball, being able to space the floor and hit threes. Defensively, he’s just a very underrated defender who can change the game.”
 Matisse Thybulle’s full numbers for the Lakers against the Suns
 Matisse Thybulle vs the Suns:
 12 points
 4-9 FG
 2-6 3PT
 2-2 FT
 8 rebounds
 0 assists
 3 steals
 2 blocks
 Thybulle is averaging 24.6 minutes for the season, playing a key role under JJ Redick, starting in all 14 games so far.
 He managed only five starts for the Portland Trail Blazers over the past two seasons.
